subject: Gravity Labs candidate brief
title: Glass treatment, block by block
lede: Five blocks of the Gravity brief, each in three depth treatments built from the ARCS tokens and the page's own copy: A flat (today), B glass (sheen plus emboss), C glow (glass plus a cyan rim). The glass-strength dial scales B and C together.

blocks.label: Header
blocks.note: Masthead and headline, the first thing read.

variants.name: Flat
variants.why: Today's look: a plain surface card.
variants.html: Zach Harris for Gravity LabsGravity's agents made ideas cheap. Judgment is still expensive. I want that job.
